description: Sitting Santa Figurine decoration for home, office, business use. Spread Christmas Holiday cheer from rooftop to floor to tables and surfaces with this small but yet presentable Santa statue figurine. This lovely collectible piece feature proudly sitting Santa Claus dressed in a black and white plaid coat, black pants and a red and white hat, holding a bag full of gifts. Add majestic, alluring accents to your seasonal display with this fancy dressed Santa ornament. Measures approximately 14” H X 9” L X 8" W” lightweight and easy to handle and position on your favorite surface.
